description: Calculate a person's monthly income, salary/earnings totals and average over fromMonth..toMonth (YYYY-MM). Resolve entityId first. name: agentQueries.searchJournals
title: Search financial records
description: Find individual financial transactions and receipts by 1–16 literal indexed memo words (text, each at most 32 characters), optionally narrowed by inclusive from/to dates, chart and attributed person. Omit dates when unknown: memo search covers recorded history without scanning unrelated journals. Results are relevance ranked with text, newest accounting date otherwise. Posting amount strings are signed major currency units, positive debit/negative credit; minorUnits are integer ledger units. Follow nextCursor even on empty date/subject-filtered pages. Use reports.finances for aggregate totals, not transaction paging.

title: agentLife: events
description: Find recorded events/appointments by title words, kind, subject and optional inclusive dates. Omit both dates to locate an existing event whose current date is unknown, including before rescheduling; never substitute its proposed new date or guess a year-end cutoff. Event titles belong here, not life.search. For the next appointment, set from=today and OMIT through: returns earliest matches across all future recorded dates, not a guessed year-end cutoff. Otherwise date-only queries are newest first; title searches are relevance ranked. Returns a saved report with exact local times, UTC offsets and repeated-clock occurrences. Use present_report for the final calendar answer; use event IDs when editing. The MCP service follows pages within its query budget. Prefer this to listing raw events; use life.timeline for upcoming commitments.

name: life.obligations
title: agentObligations: current
description: Who owes whom now? Current unpaid recorded invoices/claims, with explicit debtor, creditor, amount and due date. Choose direction=receivable for money owed TO us (anyone late paying us), payable for money WE owe (are we late paying anyone), both only for both sides. scope=household uses the configured household perspective. For another person/company use scope=dataset and perspectiveQuery; for all dataset parties use both. Optional debtorQuery (who owes), creditorQuery (who is owed), partyQuery (either side) accept unique names; query filters agreement/schedule words. With no dueThrough, includes all outstanding claims, even future due dates; overdueOnly selects late claims. Excludes projections, duplicate expected payments and loan principal. Present the exact saved report.

direction.description: Required intent: receivable = owed TO the perspective; payable = owed BY the perspective; both = both sides. Household scope supplies our household perspective.

perspectiveQuery.description: Unique person/company name for the receivable/payable perspective. Omit for our household. This differs from partyQuery, which only filters a counterparty.

name: life.timeline
title: agentTimeline: timeline
description: What is coming up? Upcoming events, commitments, due/overdue bills, rent, scheduled salary and expected payments in an inclusive date range. Defaults today through month end in dataset timezone. Settled obligations excluded, linked forecasts deduplicated. Projections clearly labeled. entityId narrows to that direct party/subject; omit it for the overall household calendar. Filter title query (words and common synonyms), direction=outflow for payments we owe, inflow for money we receive, or transfer, relative to the default household. entityId ONLY filters the involved party and never changes direction; set perspectiveId explicitly only when asking from another person’s/company’s perspective. status=due includes unpaid claims due in range and included arrears, even when linked to an expected payment; overdue selects past-due claims; expected selects cash expectations and schedule projections. Complete nonempty results return a saved report; empty results have no handle and incomplete queries fail explicitly. Status/direction filters exclude unrelated calendar events. Use life.obligations for current unpaid claims without choosing a date window. Set includeEvents=false for commitments only.

name: reports.finances
title: agentFinance: summary
description: Choose scope=household for personal/household books; scope=dataset for all books or an explicit chart/person filter. Use accountQuery for a requested expense/revenue category (e.g. groceries). Compute complete recorded financial totals over inclusive from/through dates (YYYY-MM-DD). metric: cash_balances (recorded bank cash as of through, all selected checking/savings/cash accounts in one call), payroll (gross income, actual take-home deposits and monthly averages separately; PayrollDeposit events), profit_loss (income, expense and net surplus), income (gross recognized), expenses (excludes capital purchases), balances (all history through cutoff), cashflow (signed bank-account changes; use eventKind=PayrollDeposit for recorded take-home pay), activity (signed debits/credits by account, including project capital costs). groupBy: month (default), year or total. Optional currency code and verified chart/person/beneficiary/project/tag/account IDs. Server consumes all database pages; never scan journals to calculate totals. Decimal amounts are major currency units. Currencies remain separate. reportId supports drill-down via reports.read.
